$comment: Single source of the product's display name and public host. Change them with `node scripts/apply-brand.mjs "<New Name>"` / `node scripts/apply-brand.mjs --host <new.host>`, never by hand: the script rewrites every literal copy and this file; `prebuild` fails when a copy drifts. The name is TWO words; the UI shows it followed by the alpha badge. legacyHosts keep serving and stay in every origin allowlist. Technical ids (storage keys, URL scheme, user agent, package names) are NOT covered — see docs/rename-verse-companion.md, stage 2.
